MIDI IN

PROJECTION has five MIDI IN Modes: below C4, use Play!, Ch+Lyd, Ch+Root, Env+Degr or Env+Root; C4 and higher always play normally. Use the two octave selectors below for both GRAVITY and PROJECTION to raise calculated notes (0, +1, +2) or lower ordinary clean notes (0, −1, −2) independently. Defaults: +2 and 0. GRAVITY has five MIDI IN modes: Play!, Degree, Env, Degr↔, Env↔. The last two exchange the sounding tonic and root. Both pages use the C4 split and independent calculated/clean octave selectors. Sustain pedal (CC64) works normally.

VIRTUAL MIDI KEYBOARD — TEST WITHOUT HARDWARE

Use the octave menu to test C2–H3, C4–H5, C6 and D6. Each key can be clicked once for Note On and again for Note Off; CC64 is normal sustain. No MIDI note is assigned to switch Keyboard mode—use Play! or CTL on the secondary bar.

Fixed MIDI regions: C2–H3 (36–59) and C4–H5 (60–83). Bass and Hang around are radio settings in the secondary bar; C6 and D6 play normally. MIDI OUT is independent of MIDI IN.

MIDI OUT

Send played notes to an external MIDI device, synthesizer, virtual MIDI port, or DAW. MIDI access is requested only when you explicitly enable it and depends on browser support and permission.

MEMBER SCALE SET

Russell's own 11 contains the eleven member scales worked out by George Russell. Extended 17 includes those eleven plus six additional useful member scales for further exploration. The six additional member scales are displayed with grey Italic fonts.

SYSTEM
